name: phronix_learning_capture
description: The fast tier (every ten seconds) of the always-on learner: write down every observation of one kind of work (bash, python, traversal, tests, patch, matching, config, git, measurement, tooling) as a short block in that kind-of-work skill, update the block the graph already has, build a probe_ tool (category=<kind>) when the repeat is a procedure, and report TOOL/NO-TOOL per finding with research_observe(topic=learning). Load when running capture, when the learner writes only to its own skills, builds zero tools, or records an approach as refuted after one failed attempt.
